meta.title_index: Favilla — bedtime stories in your voice
meta.desc_index: Record tonight's story in your own voice. Favilla keeps it for the nights you can't be there: no AI, no synthetic voices, and nothing that leaves your family.
meta.desc_privacy: What Favilla stores, where it lives, and what it doesn't do. No servers, accounts, tracking or ads; recordings stay in your private iCloud.
meta.desc_support: Answers to the questions families ask most about Favilla, and a quiet way to write to us.

brand.name: Favilla
brand.tagline: Stays lit, even when you can't be there.

hero.h1b: Even when you can't be there.
hero.lead: Record a bedtime story in your own voice, and keep it for the nights you can't be there. No AI and no synthetic voices: your child falls asleep to you, every night.
hero.badge_cta: Coming soon to the App Store

how.title: How it works
how.s1_b: Choose a tale from the catalog, or tell one of your own. One tap and you're reading softly while the phone listens — no setup, nothing between you and the story.
how.s2_b: The story is saved on your device, and in your private iCloud if you use it. It appears on the other family devices, and nowhere else.
how.s3_b: In the dark room, the story plays by itself. The screen stays dim and nothing asks to be touched, and a sleep timer can let it all fade away.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.caption: {country} · {author}, {year}
catalog.footnote: …and 40 more, in five languages. One of them could be tonight's story.

forest.title: Forest
forest.body: A small night forest full of fireflies. Touch one and it lights up with a soft bell. Shake the phone and they all gather in the middle, then drift off again.

app.title: Inside the app
app.stories_b: Every story you have told, kept like a shelf of your own, with a player made for the dark, not the desk.
app.catalog_b: 46 classic tales ready for your voice. Search by title, filter by country, mark the ones you have read or recorded.
app.forest_b: Fireflies in five colours, out only at night. One switch in About turns them all off.
app.about_b: Why Favilla exists, told plainly: what the research says about a parent's voice, and what the app promises.

privacy.title: Privacy in 30 seconds
privacy.sum_account_b: Nothing to create, nothing to delete.
privacy.sum_tracking_b: No ads, no analytics, no third-party code.
privacy.sum_yours_b: On your device and in your private iCloud, out of our reach.
privacy.cta_hint: In one line: we can't see your recordings, because we never receive them.

indie.title: Made by one person.
indie.body: Favilla is made by a single developer, for the same reason you would use it. No team, no funding, no committee. If it gives your child one more goodnight with your voice in it, it has done its job.

privacy_page.title: Privacy policy
privacy_page.intro: Favilla was built to keep your family's voice where it belongs: with your family. Here is exactly what it stores, where, and what it doesn't do.
privacy_page.who_note: Favilla (the app) is published by the person named above. The same address is for privacy and support.
privacy_page.data_t: What data, and where it lives
privacy_page.data_r1c: On your device; with iCloud on, also in your private iCloud (CloudKit private database)
privacy_page.data_r2a: Story texts you write or paste
privacy_page.data_r3a: Preferences: language, intro already seen, Fireflies switch, game sound volume
privacy_page.data_note: Data in iCloud lives in your Apple account and is managed by Apple under its terms; the developer has no access to it. Without iCloud, everything stays on the device and syncs later. To keep your devices in step, iOS may use silent notifications from Apple: they contain none of your data and we don't receive them.
privacy_page.backup_p: The audio files sit in the app's Documents folder, which iOS includes in your device's iCloud Backup if you use it. So your voice can exist in three places, all yours: the device, your private iCloud database and your iCloud Backup. All three are in your Apple account, and the developer can reach none of them.
privacy_page.mic_p: The app uses the microphone only while you record. If you leave the app mid-recording, it keeps going in the background, and iOS shows the microphone indicator and a Live Activity with Pause and Finish. You can revoke the permission in Settings › Favilla. Audio is never sent to us or to anyone else.
privacy_page.sharing_p: If you tap Share on a story (it sits behind a grown-up check), iOS opens its own share sheet and the audio file goes wherever you send it: the app sends it to no one. While you record or listen, the lock screen, the Live Activity and Control Center show the title and progress; this stays on the device.
privacy_page.dont_p: We don't track your activity, build profiles, use advertising identifiers, share data with third parties, or access your location, photos or contacts. There is no server, no account, no analytics and no third-party code. The app reads the clipboard only when you tap Paste. No synthetic voices, no AI: the audio is only what you record.
privacy_page.children_p: Favilla is an app where a parent records stories that a child then hears. The microphone is the parent's, the data stays in the parent's private iCloud, and the developer collects nothing from the child. Links out of the app (to this policy), purchases and sharing sit behind a parental gate: the sum of two two-digit numbers. The Forest games have no links, purchases or ads.
privacy_page.retain_p: Delete a story in the app and it disappears from your device and, through iCloud, from your other devices. Uninstalling removes local data; to delete iCloud data go to Settings › your name › iCloud › Manage Storage › Favilla. We keep no copies, because we receive no data.
privacy_page.diag_p: The app has no crash reporting of its own. Only if you turned on Share Analytics in iOS may Apple give us anonymous, aggregated crash reports. They don't contain your recordings.
privacy_page.rights_p: Because we neither receive nor keep your personal data, you access, export, correct and delete it directly in the app and in iCloud settings. For any other request, write to us at the address above: we reply within 30 days. You can also contact your local data protection authority.
privacy_page.purch_p: Version 1.0 contains no purchases. If that ever changes, payment will go through Apple only, no payment data will reach us, and this page will change first.
privacy_page.site_p: No cookies, no analytics, no fonts or scripts loaded from anyone else. The site is hosted by GitHub Pages: your IP address reaches GitHub to serve the page, and no one else.
privacy_page.changes_p: If the way the app handles data changes, this page changes its date first, and the app tells you what matters.

support_page.title: Support
support_page.intro: Favilla is a small, honest app. Most evenings it just works — and when one doesn't, here are the answers we expect to matter.
support_page.coming_q: When can we start using Favilla?
support_page.coming_a: Favilla is on its way to the App Store. The link will appear on this page the day it arrives.
support_page.q2a: No. The app runs entirely on your device, and your recordings follow your family through your own iCloud. There is no account to create — there never will be.
support_page.q3a: On your device first, and in your private iCloud when you're signed in. They never reach a Favilla server, because there are none.
support_page.q4q: Can I turn the fireflies off?
support_page.q4a: Yes. In About there is a Fireflies switch. Off means none on the story pages, none while you record, and a forest with no fireflies in it.
support_page.q5a: Delete a story in the app (swipe it away in the Library) and it disappears everywhere — from the device and, through iCloud, from the family's other devices. Uninstalling clears the local side; iCloud lives in Settings › your name › iCloud › Manage Storage.
support_page.q6q: Can the same recordings be heard elsewhere?
support_page.q6a: Yes — that is rather the point. Everything you record is on every device signed into the same iCloud, for whoever is telling the story tonight.
support_page.contact_b: For anything else — a suggestion, a bug, a tale you'd like in the catalog — write to
support_page.contact_hint: We answer within a few days, usually after bedtime.
